notes.title: [1.1.1] Update: Easier difficulty and hit detection added
notes.content:
Hello, [Thy Creature] players!
We would like to express our gratitude to everyone who has shown interest and patiently awaited the updates.
We have two major updates to announce:

1. Bullet Hell Difficulty Adjustment
To ensure that even those who are unfamiliar with bullet hell games can enjoy the experience, we have adjusted the game's difficulty. If you found the gameplay challenging before and hesitated to continue or even stopped playing, we encourage you to give it another try.

2. Hit Detection Indicator
In this update, we have also added a hit detection indicator. You can now clearly see which part of the character has been hit. Discover more effective ways and achieve victory in the bullet hell.

Furthermore, this update includes several bug fixes and improvements to enhance the game's performance and stability. Players can expect a smoother and more stable gameplay experience.

We sincerely thank all of you who love [Thy Creature], and we will continue to do our best to provide an even more advanced gaming experience in the future.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Thy Creature Official Version Update & Release Discount Offer]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/2e114c208ed86f22c461a4eadbcdd0229f3f7a86.png[/img]
[b]"Thy Creature" has been updated to the official version.[/b]

We thank everyone who has waited for us to release the official version. 
To celebrate the release, we are having a 30% discount offer for a week (Nov 15th to 22nd)

The official version has many new features compared to the early access version. 
1. In early access, you could only reach the 2nd floor of the tower. In the official version, you can reach all floors of the tower.
2. Powerful, infatuating, intense bosses were added along with bullet hell features.
3. Many puzzles have been added which you must solve to climb the tower 
4. New characters will appear! Play the official version and help those who have had their memories stolen.
5. Play through the story of the "Creature," who wishes to find its maker in the tower.

Thank you!

notes.title: [Thy Creature] Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello, we are MazM, the development team of <Thy Creature>.

We would like to share with you about [Official Release Version (Demo)] that was released on BIC and TGS.

Many points have been updated in the previous Early Access version of the version released in the above exhibition.
We would like to thank all of you who played Early Access and left various opinions.

Unfortunately, this version is only available at BIC and TGS events.
We wanted to update the Steam version and show it to many people, but we are very sorry that we cannot officially disclose it due to translation and development issues.
All the team members are working hard for the official launch, so please give them a lot.

In this [Official Release Version (Demo)], we will share information about the parts that are different and updated from [Early Access Version].


[h2]1. LARGER MAP[/h2]
The world that you can explore is bigger.
Find special and hidden spaces.

[h2]2. ITEM[/h2]
You can obtain information about the story, or you can obtain the items you need to proceed with the story.
Items can be found in various ways, such as passing by, talking to residents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/87270d592c1a6e55ee7e838046b411964295c3ce.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/4d2cd304f8954a941ca62c7b996e7be2c5295402.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/6220de6596196f6056fb1da079814c58e71f75a7.jpg[/img]

[h2]3. UPGRADED  BULLET HELL[/h2]
Patterns that actively utilize puzzles appear.
After you clear it, you can look at the hidden memories and get a fragment of them.
You can face the Nepes who are roaming around the map and regain your memory, or you can avoid it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/ac80c11502cb0124de55c713a56a9380ed35b73e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/d2735d1bd6604eb40f49bfe08897ce699ce66456.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/87e31a2ace890ca4d743ec6072ff5e45bbc8f97b.gif[/img]

[h2]4. NEW STORY AND NEW RESIDENTS[/h2]
You will be able to see improved production and changed stories.
You can meet new residents.
Go up the tower listening to their stories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/7bebaa50f57cc053af62bf271257010c79596a1d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/34d90ed598de16e5fc53c08902ed9c7e07fa1c41.gif[/img]


That's all for this devlog.
In the next development journal, we'll find information about new residents.
Thank you.

notes.title: [Thy Creature] Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hello, we are MazM, the development team of <Thy Creature>.

It's been three months since Early Access opened.
The first Devlog would like to share the concepts of the bosses who will appear in the future.

<BOSS : Madness>
"There's so much inside you... that I'd like to unravel."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/3f3e94968ec61d78548927cbbaa4d7a2782d87de.png[/img]

<BOSS : Happiness>
"Come here, I will free you from this terrible pain."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/10d8d46aa45e1260a724d972b8f958c48cdc4b2a.png[/img]

<BOSS: Disgust>
"You're amazing. unlike me."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/719d9df7f22ab985ba51e3c8e167141665b50fc4.png[/img]

<BOSS : Loss>
"... ..."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/172ffd7bcc6b2c6fed819bf697b5584aac155bc7.png[/img]

A total of four additional bosses will appear in the release version.
Each boss has special memories,
You'll be able to see various difficulty levels of bullet hell and puzzles to feel the boss' theme.


[h3][Question to character artist][/h3]

[b][Q] What was the focus of the boss characters' concept?[/b]
[A] I wanted to design characters that can be attractive to users while melting the themes of each floor of the tower, which is the stage of <Thy Creature>, so I focused on that part the most.

[b][Q] Were there any boss characters that were particularly difficult to work on? What's the reason?[/b]
[A] The Madness boss was the hardest.  Now, it has been organized as "Madness about knowledge," but in the beginning, it was "Madness about Victor's 'CREATION OF LIFE' knowledge," and all the elements in the theme were strong keywords, so I remember having a hard time focusing on where to design.

[b][Q] What was your favorite boss character? What's the reason?[/b]
[A] I like the design of the Happiness boss the most. It worked out when I worked on the concept and it's my personal preference.


That's all for this Devlog.
In the next Devlog, We will come back with new elements.
Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/b0f0aedcdee8825ba4ab40f618b962eb3febdaf4.png[/img]

notes.title: [0.7.1] Early Access Patch
notes.content:
This patch is intended to improve difficulty and other game design features.
After this update, we plan to implement our roadmap that we made public. We aim to release v1.0 by the end of this year.
Thank you very much for playing the Early Access version of our game.

[h1]Update Details[/h1]

[h1]Difficulty Updates[/h1]
- Increased difficulty of Floor 1's overall level design.
- Improved to better fit the puzzles on Floor 1.

[h1]Special Effects Updates[/h1]
- Adjusted the speed of some special effects.
- Improved to better reveal the features of characters.

[h1]Other Updates[/h1]
- Changed typeface to a more legible font.
- Added some missing text.

[h1]Developer Q&A[/h1]

[We talked to the Game Designers who worked on this update.]
Q: We noticed that the Bullet Hell part became slightly more difficult in this update. What's behind this decision?
A: We wanted to make the bullet hell in Floor 1 more interesting, and add a special identity like that of Floor 2.

[We talked to the Game Designers who worked on this update.]
Q: What's the aspect that you focused on the most in this update?
A: We changed the speed at which character's lines pop up when keys are pressed and tried to make it easier to understand the characters.

notes.title: DEVELOPMENT ROADMAP
notes.content:
Hi! This is MazM, the developer team of <Thy Creature>.

Thank you for playing <Thy Creature>. 
Your valuable feedback has really helped us to head in the right direction. 
Through this space, we would like to inform you about our development process, direction, updates, improvements, and much more.

[h1][b]Roadmap Summary[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/fce1b045f9f7c353cc64b441079e29d2bb85b07a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The official release of <Thy Creature> is expected to happen during the second half of 2022.
[*] There is a big update coming up for early access during the second half of 2022.
[*] Additional Story & Skills
[*] You can experience the changes before the official release.
[*] We are recruiting test users during the first half of 2022.
[*] We would like to recruit testers not open to public, to show our process of changes and receive feedbacks. 
[/list]

[h1][b]Direction of Development[/b][/h1]

We will fix any bugs/problems/errors in the current version, add more stories, and improve the puzzle and shooting elements of the game.

[h1][b]Various Residents & New Events[/b][/h1]

As you go up the tower, you will face various residents who have been living in there. Once you help them retrieve their memories, some might even become friends with you, and help in different ways.

In the official version, there will be an additional system for playing the events involving the residents and acquire factors that will help players.

[h1][b]Various Nepes, New Patterns & Levels of Difficulty[/b][/h1]

As you ascend the tower, you will be able to see charming Nepes with many different styles.
They have new bullet hell & puzzle patterns as well as difficulty levels, to provide different experiences.

The official version will be more difficult than the current early access version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40318473/14f2fa2ab9c7ed33b5449f15ebd4a8c8138feb2e.png[/img]

[h1][b]Newly Added Stories[/b][/h1]

Players will continue the journey towards the top of the tower with the creature. 
The creature will gradually grow as it retrieves its memories from the Nepes, and eventually discovers the secrets of the tower. 

In the official version, the stories and presentation will be balanced so that the playing experience would not be loose. 

[h1][b]More Collections & Exploration[/b][/h1]

New items and a collection system will be added.
Within this system, you will experience more diverse interactions, puzzles, exploration, and much more. 

[h1][b]Better User Preferences[/b][/h1]

User preference settings such as key conversion, resolution choices, and joypad support will be improved for a better user experience.

<Thy Creature> sincerely appreciates your feedback.
Your interest and feedback really help our team, MazM, to develop better games.
We appreciate all your support and feedback.
Thank you.
